data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's prior-year (2020) gross claims estimates showed a small favourable development, producing a gross release of approximately GBP 0.382m (around 6.7% of the opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 5.717m). This movement appears driven by favourable claims development / IBNR recalibration on the 2020 underwriting year across the Syndicate's Property and Casualty portfolios.
raw_causal_phrases: The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.
judgement is applied when estimating the value of amounts that should be provided for claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported (IBNR) to the Syndicate.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was not stated as a single gross movement in the notes; gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative gross outstanding claims by underwriting year). The triangle is limited to underwriting years 2020-2022; only 2020 qualifies as a 'prior year' (excluding 2021 and 2022). No explicit textual sentence quantifying the gross prior-year movement was found. Numbers in the claims development table are presented in GBP '000 (units provided).
